[[File:Carbosyrup.png|thumb|right|200px|Carbosyrup]]
'''Carbosyrup''' was a thick, liquid [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] filled with [[Sugar/Legends|sugars]] and [[Carbohydrate/Legends|carbohydrates]]. In the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], up to twelve different flavors of carbosyrup could be found, all of which came in bottles that lit up when opened.
